description:
Goal

A demanded physical transport answer monotonically refines exact semantic producer/use relations into one ABI contract. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer directly; no layer reselects identity from Ty, ShapeId, debug text, broad callsite summaries, or session inventories.

Signal

- The original enum-reduce fixture compiles warning-free with materially fewer products/events and no telemetry-only allocation.
- Callable call alternatives retain their exact (surface, target alternative or explicit unknown, invocation endpoint) relation through every join.
- Callsite-tagged return payloads name only the producer/surface alternatives that can reach that endpoint.
- One producer used by several endpoints and one endpoint reached by several producers settle one common physical source ABI; boundary wrappers emit it and caller continuations adapt it to caller-local destinations.
- Forward/reverse service, equal reproduction, replacement, withdrawal, and unrelated-reader coldness agree.
- Full library tests, strict clippy, formatting, targeted interpreter/JIT fixtures, and release telemetry/performance gates pass.

North-star constraints

- One requested product reads exact current fact/product authorities or returns exact waits. There is no seal, pass, whole-world census, session scan, no-change signal, or downstream reconstruction.
- Only actual product back-edges form a local settlement group, and only settled immutable answers publish.
- Physical ids are values, never semantic owners. Exact semantic relations and TransportPosition owners survive until physical interning.
- No copied Ty/demand/provenance snapshot, reverse index, summary rescan, selector, fallback, or wrapper compensation may replace a relation discarded upstream.
- Telemetry emitters pass borrowed raw authorities and minimal scalars; handlers alone inspect, transform, or retain.

Established foundation

fz-k22.5.1 supplies immutable revisioned products, exact durable dependencies, final movement states, replaceable per-publisher contributions, exact incoming-input relations, and targeted retraction.

The spike has proved the intended lower model for ordinary positions: ExecutableInput owns its ABI from settled ActivationInputs plus RuntimeDemand; CallArg conforms to the selected input; ExecutableFacts owns normalized local structure without copied Ty/demand/layout data; TransportShape and CallableConstruction are separate position-owned domains; exact recursive shape and pass-through owner back-edges settle atomically; callable/boundary facts embed through ABI/backend values instead of physical-id inventories. The legacy closure/component solver, demanded-id stores, global callable/boundary products, selector/fallback paths, and custom freshness ledgers are deletion targets.

Falsified hypotheses

Callable target return demand is not missing. In the discordant enum traces, caller endpoint Ty/demand matches the selected target and the target already carries that demand. boundary_return_demands = Vec::new() is obsolete scaffolding, not the cause.

Selecting one target or filtering a broad callsite summary in transport is also wrong. Producer sets can require a common ABI, and transport must consume preserved relations rather than reconstruct them.

First proven data loss

CallableDemand stores targets and invocation_returns as independent sets. arg_demands_for_summary joins target input demands fieldwise, manufacturing a Cartesian product before CallableFlowBuilder or transport runs.

Minimal proof:

    fn call(f, x), do: f.(x)

    fn main(flag) do
      p = fn (x) -> {:p, x} end
      q = fn (x) -> x end
      a = call(p, 1)
      selected = if flag, do: p, else: q
      b = call(selected, 2)
      {a, b, p}
    end

Main V1 is P, V2 is Q, V5 is their delivered join, V4 is call A's return, and V7 is call B's return. For call(selected, 2), arg_demands_for_summary receives one target-helper contribution carrying (P, endpoint A) and another carrying (Q, endpoint B). RuntimeDemand::join_assign stores {P,Q} and {A,B} independently. V5 then legitimately flows backward to both sources, so V1, V2, and V5 all expose A+B. CallableFlowBuilder, grounding, and edge construction copy the already-corrupted relation.

This is the earliest wrong fact. Later TransportSource::CallsiteReturn broadens it again by walking every CallSiteSummary target, including targets from other callable surfaces. The observed enum endpoint discordances are downstream symptoms, not repair sites.

Required semantic model proof before implementation

Replace the independent fields for a call with a set of alternatives whose element retains the endpoint and the exact target alternative that produced its input demand, or an explicit Unknown target. Join must be set union over complete alternatives. Later producer-flow derivation may only refine a preserved alternative; it may not re-pair independent projections.

Prove:
1. the minimal fixture retains P-A and Q-B without P-B or Q-A;
2. a true P-A/P-B/Q-B value-flow graph retains exactly those three pairs;
3. direct, multi-target, opaque/unknown, returned, recursive, and producer-publication cases keep the required information;
4. the new relational value can delete or derive the old independent targets and invocation_returns duties rather than duplicate them;
5. order, replacement, and retraction are monotone and exact.

Required physical model proof after semantic correlation is exact

Callsite-tagged ReturnPayload and ResumePayload are callee/boundary source ABIs. ExecutableReturn and untagged ResumePayload are caller-local destinations. The current model conflates them and reconstructs source anchors from CallSiteSummary.

With exact producer/endpoint pairs established, prove the bipartite contract graph: producer/surface boundary-return nodes connect to their exact invocation endpoint nodes; target ExecutableReturn layouts are anchors; every connected ABI node settles one common representation because an indirect continuation and boxed callable surface each have one static signature.

Cover the two real enum discordances, structurally different producers at one endpoint, one producer at several endpoints, a connected P-A/P-B/Q-B graph, enum-take's three-lane producer/two-lane caller conversion at the caller continuation, generic/opaque inputs, and uncalled publication. Accept a product SCC only for genuine exact back-edges, with finite monotone equations, durable dependencies, atomic publication, and no session inventory.

Implementation strategy after both proofs

1. Pin production-path intent tests and classify old tests as semantic invariants, obsolete representation pins, or resource ceilings.
2. Replace independent callable call fields with the proved relational alternative and delete re-correlation logic.
3. Preserve exact producer/surface-to-endpoint facts in the demand product without a reverse scan.
4. Give source payloads and semantic boundary returns explicit position ownership; make boundary construction consume the common contract and leave caller-local conversion to the existing continuation path.
5. Delete obsolete CallableReturnAuthority selection, broad CallsiteReturn source reconstruction, empty boundary-return-demand scaffolding, and wrapper-side compensation.
6. Finish the position-owned cutover, embed owner values in artifacts, delete legacy inventories/solvers/tests, update northstar and agent docs, remove every spike/probe, then run all correctness and telemetry/performance gates.

fz-k22.30 remains blocked until this lands. fz-k22.31 owns only a genuinely uncalled first-class discrepancy if one remains after the relational model is complete.
title: Make transport shape a product-owned refinement
